bagPolicy.summary: PNC Arena does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking is accessible via Edwards Mill Road from I-40 or Wade Avenue. Follow signs to the main entrance for parking options. For more details, refer to the Parking Guide.

rideshare.note: Taxi services may be available in the drop off and pick up area located in gate C (near the TowneBank Center). Lenovo Center Rideshare offers convenient, one-stop drop-off and pick-up location across the main roadway from VIP Parking, next to Townebank Center at Carter-Finley Stadium.

concessions.note: PNC Arena offers a diverse range of food and drink options including gourmet hot dogs, Peruvian chicken, and signature mac & cheese bowls. Special offerings include Willy's Hot Chicken with multiple spice levels and Sup Dogs' branded vodka drinks.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Sensory Bags, Weighted Lap Pads, and Photosensitivity Glasses: Available for guests to check-out at Guest Services (Section 127) at no cost. Accessible Seating is available throughout all levels of the facility.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Exit / Re-entry into Lenovo Center is NOT permitted, including for smoking.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at PNC Arena. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at PNC Arena. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
